project_title: Primary Healthcare Accessibility and Underservice in Kano State, Nigeria
theme: Primary Healthcare Accessibility and Spatial Planning
summary: Road-network travel-time and 15-minute 2SFCA assessment of primary healthcare spatial availability, underserved wards, planning priorities and validated +5, +10 and +20 PHC expansion scenarios across Kano State.
author: Abdullah Abdazeez Ayomide
interpretation: 2SFCA is facility-count-based and measures modeled spatial availability. It does not measure staffing, service capacity, healthcare quality, patient utilization or health outcomes.
